title: Task state transitions are linearizable per task id
statement: For a given task id, observed transitions MUST follow the documented state machine (queued → ready → in_progress → checkpoint → pre_merge → merging → completed | escalated | rgr_pending | cancelled). Concurrent readers of .devai/state/tasks/<id>.json MUST NOT observe a state inconsistent with the last committed write; intermediate state files MUST NOT be surfaced.
rationale: Article 21 makes the task lifecycle (including its escalation tail) the auditable trail of the loop. A reader that observes an out-of-order state would invalidate every downstream audit. Persistence uses write-then-replace on a single JSON file so the on-disk record is always a complete snapshot of a valid transition.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
